description: Roster or team-listing surface — avatars, roles, availability chips. Renders on shi-design ViewNode → SwiftUIRenderer, tuned by SMWidgetDisplaySize (compact / regular / expanded).
Shoppable product card — image, title, price (with strikethrough compare-at when discounted), variant options, add-to-cart. Falls through to the plain SMProduct layout when products list is empty.
QR-code atom composited into a card — payload string in, matrix out, rendered at three responsive sizes.
In-store endcap — feature image, headline, secondary CTA, brand accent bar. The shelf-edge merchandising surface for c-tech commerce.
Video / stream program guide — time-slotted rows with poster art, title, subtitle, and now-playing state.
Cart drawer — line items with quantity steppers, running total, checkout CTA. Empty / syncing / error states in the state matrix.
